_comment: TEMPORARY estimate - replace with a checkerboard calibration (same 1920x1080 24p video mode).

source.method: Nadir flight self-calibration: image speed (phase correlation, frame to frame) = f * ground speed / height; robust linear fit with an offset term over 2054 frames where gimbal pitch < -88 deg, speed > 2 m/s, yaw rate < 3 deg/s, |vz| < 0.3 m/s.
source.flight: data/flight_logs/DJIFlightRecord_2026-11-02_[14-22-12]-aircraft.csv + DJI_00013.mp4 (video t=0 at log t=25.15 s)
source.cross_check: DJI spec 20 mm (35 mm equiv.) lens; if 1080p uses the full 4:3 sensor width -> HFOV 84.0 deg, f = 1066 px (+3% vs this estimate).
source.unknown: Lens distortion is NOT estimated (set to 0); the 94 deg wide lens has visible barrel distortion, so positions near the image edges will be less accurate. Principal point assumed at the image centre.
source.error_sources: Barometric height (+-0.5-1 m at 20 m = 3-5%), ground not exactly at takeoff height, residual gimbal motion.
